low.title: Low-Budget Half-Day Hallstatt Art Walk
low.summary: An affordable art-inspired route through Hallstatt’s prettiest corners, scenic views, and simple bites.

schedule.title: Lakefront Art Start
schedule.description: Begin with the iconic lakeside view — the classic Hallstatt shot filled with symmetry, colors, and alpine charm.

schedule.title: Old Town Artistic Corners
schedule.description: Walk through narrow wooden-house streets, discovering balconies, carvings, murals, and tiny artisan details.

schedule.title: Budget Snack Break
schedule.description: Grab a simple pastry, pretzel, or small sandwich before continuing your art walk.

schedule.title: Church Terrace Viewpoint
schedule.description: Enjoy one of Hallstatt’s most photogenic viewpoints — rooftops, lake, and mountains perfectly aligned.

schedule.title: Calm Lakeside Finish
schedule.description: End the walk by relaxing next to the water, ideal for sketching or light photography.

medium.title: Balanced Half-Day Hallstatt Art Experience
medium.summary: A comfortable art-themed route with iconic views, architecture, and a mid-range local lunch.

schedule.title: Café Start With Scenic Inspiration
schedule.description: Warm up with a pastry or tea while enjoying lake reflections — the perfect artistic intro.

schedule.title: Hallstatt Museum Art Highlights
schedule.description: Explore archaeological pieces, historic craftsmanship, and objects that inspired the famed Hallstatt culture.

schedule.title: Medium Local Lunch
schedule.description: Enjoy a reasonably priced Austrian meal before heading into village art corners.

schedule.title: Architecture & Street Aesthetics Walk
schedule.description: Walk the charming central streets, noticing wooden facades, carved details, and artisan touches everywhere.

schedule.title: Lakefront Artistic Moment
schedule.description: Finish your tour with a peaceful view — perfect for photography or creative reflection.

high.title: High-End Hallstatt Art Highlights
high.summary: A refined half-day art route with elegant architecture, curated museum time, and premium-quality dining.

schedule.title: Scenic Breakfast for Creative Warm-Up
schedule.description: Begin with a beautifully served breakfast in a café overlooking the lake.

schedule.title: Curated Hallstatt Museum Experience
schedule.description: Take extra time with the artistic and cultural exhibits — tools, ornaments, ancient craftsmanship.

schedule.title: High-Quality Local Lunch
schedule.description: Taste a refined Austrian dish with fresh, local ingredients and good presentation.

schedule.title: Elegant Architecture Walk
schedule.description: Stroll through Hallstatt’s most aesthetic streets, noticing symmetry, texture, and wooden artistry.

schedule.title: Premium Photo Terrace
schedule.description: End at the iconic viewpoint where lake, village, and mountains blend into the perfect frame.

comfortable.title: Luxury Half-Day Hallstatt Art Journey
comfortable.summary: A luxurious art-focused route featuring curated museum highlights, premium meals, and the most beautiful angles of Hallstatt.

schedule.title: Elegant Breakfast With Lake Panorama
schedule.description: Start the day with top-tier pastries or light delicacies and a masterpiece view.

schedule.title: Guided or Curated Museum Visit
schedule.description: Explore cultural treasures, beautifully displayed artifacts, and the roots of Hallstatt’s artistic identity.

schedule.title: Fine Dining Art-Inspired Lunch
schedule.description: Enjoy artistic plating and refined Austrian flavors.

schedule.title: Exclusive Architecture & Aesthetic Corners
schedule.description: Walk the most polished parts of the village — premium photography spots guaranteed.

schedule.title: Luxury Lakefront Finale
schedule.description: Relax at the most scenic lake viewpoint, ideal for finishing your art-filled day.
